jzMockEPaper2Question19.resolution: The original word guarantee admits more than one reading. The publisher solution establishes that ambiguity must remain after learning any four actual truth values. supplementalTeaching.scope: Supplemental source, complete-solution and cumulative-hint captures of exact compiled Mock E in Normal/Pearson at390/1280px. Local isolated synthetic state only; external requests are blocked. Capture/geometry evidence only, not independent mathematical approval

gaps.reason: One cubic derivative/root-shape transfer was retained. No second distinct official task matched the restricted-interval monotonicity versus root-count comparison closely enough.
Two distinct official equation-audit tasks cover zero-factor cancellation and principal-root squaring checks. A third fresh operation match was not found.
Two shared-input truth/set-containment tasks were retained. Other logic questions without these exact mathematical operations were not added.
One squared-trigonometric branch-count problem was retained. Other trigonometric exercises did not require the same identity plus complete endpoint recovery.

No precise unused official match was found for modulus implication chains under an exact truth count. 2016 P2 Q8 was excluded: adding inequalities and bounding a product is a different decisive operation.
One parameterised quadratic-vertex transfer was retained. Distance optimisation is explicitly candidate-only, and no additional direct vertex-locus truth audit was found.
Two AP/GP elimination problems were retained. Neither repeats the original logarithmic transformation; no third distinct close common-term operation was justified.
One sine-branch triangle-count problem was retained. 2018 P2 Q14 was excluded because its authored ray/circle SSA-height test does not practise the original angle-domain comparison directly enough.
One split-polynomial-area prerequisite was retained. No separate official task closely matched the complete parameterised absolute-area optimisation.
One remainder-identity prerequisite was retained. No further distinct official problem matched the combination of several evaluations and the polynomial degree bound.
Two supplied-definition/nested-quantifier negations were retained. Generic necessary/sufficient questions without that ordered negation operation were omitted.
One quantified implication/sole-truth consistency problem was retained. Other near-template or broadly logical problems were not used to fill the quota.
Two complete-binomial-ratio calculations were retained, with their different term-index and minimisation demands made explicit. No third equally close fresh problem was found.
Two diagonal/quadrilateral implication and counterexample problems were retained. Unrelated coordinate or angle exercises were not included.
One integer-part-definition interval transfer was retained. It does not repeat the original composition or equation counting; no direct official counterpart was found.
Two trapezium-error tasks cover curvature/implications and reflected/complemented areas. No third official problem practised the changing-grid counterexample construction closely enough.

No close official match was found for deriving the regular-tetrahedron sphere-radius ratio before summing nested volumes. 2016 P1 Q12 was excluded because its cylinder/hemisphere constraint optimisation uses different geometry and objective.
One separated-GP-term surd-sum problem was retained. Other progression problems lacking the ratio-root and convergence operations were not added.
One finite-information partition/minimum-query transfer was retained. Its response is a matching-position count, rather than the original truth-check policy, and that extra distinction is explicit.
Two geometric implication tasks cover triangle cuts and kite-diagonal right-angle relations. No third close official dissection/tiling-converse problem was found.
